blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines, Less than 24 hours after surviving a tough test, Alex Eala faces another stiff challenge against Greek former World No. 3 Maria Sakkari in the Hong Kong Open semifinals on Saturday. The second-seeded Eala still hasn’t dropped a set in the WTA 250 tournament, but she was pushed to her limit in a two-set battle by Croatian Antonia Ruzic, 7-6(7), 7-5, on Friday night. The match lasted for two hours and 30 minutes and was even suspended for over 20 minutes due to rain. She also had to battle through Czech Tereza Valentova, 6-4, 7-6(7), in the round of […]...
